(1) the performance of a scene segmentation algorithm is improved when using a texture feature set that includes a combination of local and global features, and (2) the performance of the scene segmentation algorithm is further improved by using a combination of machine learning algorithms.
the SVM algorithm is the most effective machine learning algorithm for classification of high dimensional textural information.

(a) the use of texture information is a viable option in cross-country navigation, but (b) the use of high dimensional feature vectors is problematic and (c) the use of machine learning algorithms can be used to address this issue, but (d) the use of a single machine learning algorithm does not guarantee the best results.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a machine learning algorithm for the classification of high dimensional feature vectors.
the development of a robust and efficient method for the visual navigation of unmanned ground vehicle in cross-country environment.
visual navigation of unmanned ground vehicle in cross-country environments, where the terrain is not structured and the scene is cluttered.

the best results were obtained by using a combination of the three machine learning algorithms.
the best results are achieved with the use of Support Vector Machines (SVM) for classification of high dimensional features.
the use of machine learning algorithms in combination with textural information can improve the performance of visual navigation systems for unmanned ground vehicles in the cross-country environment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of texturally based features is not as effective as color or laser range features for scene segmentation.
we have shown that a combination of the machine learning algorithms can be used to classify high-dimensional texture features with a reasonable accuracy and a reasonable speed.
the use of texture information for scene segmentation is still in its early stage and that the machine learning algorithms are very useful tools for solving the problem.

a machine learning algorithm that is capable of learning a nonlinear function from the data can significantly improve the performance of a navigation algorithm that uses textural information.
